results.statement: sc-lint's PORT-010 rule must not report a pub #[cfg(unix)]-only POSIX helper with no Windows counterpart, such as is_owned_by_uid and current_uid in atm-core's crates/atm-core/src/atm_temp.rs.
results.quote:
S8  (only the pub caveat) pub cfg(unix)-only POSIX helpers (`is_owned_by_uid`, `current_uid` in atm_temp.rs) with no Windows counterpart because the concept does not exist; Windows uses a different check. Row 1. Sc-lint docs say pub items stay checked, so the sc-lint team must choose: exempt (S1 transitively) or keep reporting. Not a parity gap.
Rand ruling (relayed by team-lead 2026-10-30): "S8 = EXEMPT pub POSIX-only helpers"
results.context: Phase M planning; #786 S8 text plus Rand's ruling relayed by team-lead 2026-10-30
results.deterministic_check: A port010 fixture of atm_temp.rs-style pub is_owned_by_uid/current_uid helpers reports no PORT-010 finding; PORT-010 docs state the pub-helper exemption.
results.explanation: This bead proposes something the anchor rules out.
